name: Pate Acoo
bio: Acoo makes his own case to the court. He is not obliged to honor a safeguard his father sought, and he holds no established shahbandar appointment.
notes: fact: Pires names him as Utimutiraja’s son and an opponent of peace in 1511 (Pires II, p. 280)

inference: Earlier and later passages name no son in the relevant fighting and execution episodes; those references do not establish Acoo’s individual fate (Pires II, pp. 255, 257, 281; Birch III, pp. 125–127, 147–151)
gameplay: Court referrals distinct from his father’s are invented (people-factions.md §2)
